hypothesis: At least one of 16 seed-selected tournaments exhibits an apparent change in exact minimum frustration after the preregistered vertex relabelling or global relation reversal.
alternatives: No representation mismatch is observed; the apparent representation effect is absorbed by the declared negative controls.
A representation mismatch remains after one or both declared negative controls.

observables.measure: mask, local summary and three exact minima per sample
counts by exact minimum backward-edge value
maximum exact minimum backward-edge count in the sample
sum of exact minimum backward-edge counts

controls.purpose: Negative control: test whether the apparent effect survives a preregistered change of vertex labels.
Negative control: test whether the apparent effect survives reversal of every directed relation.

analysis.stoppingRule: Execute exactly 16 LCG-generated masks once; do not extend, replace or rerun the sample after observing any result.
analysis.comparisonPlan: Count every relabelling and reversal mismatch. If the total is zero, classify the proposed representation effect as absorbed by the declared negative controls.
